mapper.select: SELECT game_id AS "gameId", cooldown_id AS "cooldownId", ability_id AS "abilityId", duration_formula_key AS "durationFormulaKey", starts_on_phase_id AS "startsOnPhaseId", group_key AS "groupKey", change_revision AS "changeRevision", updated_at AS "updatedAt" FROM public.ability_cooldowns WHERE game_id = #{gameId} AND cooldown_id = #{cooldownId}
mapper.update: INSERT INTO public.ability_cooldowns (game_id, cooldown_id, ability_id, duration_formula_key, starts_on_phase_id, group_key, change_revision, updated_at) VALUES (#{gameId}, #{cooldownId}, #{abilityId}, #{durationFormulaKey}, #{startsOnPhaseId}, #{groupKey}, #{changeRevision}, NOW()) ON CONFLICT (game_id, cooldown_id) DO UPDATE SET ability_id = EXCLUDED.ability_id, duration_formula_key = EXCLUDED.duration_formula_key, starts_on_phase_id = EXCLUDED.starts_on_phase_id, group_key = EXCLUDED.group_key, change_revision = EXCLUDED.change_revision, updated_at = NOW()
mapper.select: SELECT game_id AS "gameId", cooldown_id AS "cooldownId", ability_id AS "abilityId", duration_formula_key AS "durationFormulaKey", starts_on_phase_id AS "startsOnPhaseId", group_key AS "groupKey", change_revision AS "changeRevision", updated_at AS "updatedAt" FROM public.ability_cooldowns WHERE game_id = #{gameId} AND change_revision > #{previousRevision} AND change_revision <= #{publishRevision} ORDER BY change_revision, cooldown_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO public.ability_cooldowns_log ( game_id, version_id, change_revision, cooldown_id, ability_id, duration_formula_key, starts_on_phase_id, group_key ) SELECT game_id, #{versionId}, change_revision, cooldown_id, ability_id, duration_formula_key, starts_on_phase_id, group_key FROM public.ability_cooldowns WHERE game_id = #{gameId} AND change_revision > #{previousRevision} AND change_revision <= #{publishRevision} ON CONFLICT (game_id, cooldown_id, version_id) DO UPDATE SET change_revision = EXCLUDED.change_revision, ability_id = EXCLUDED.ability_id, duration_formula_key = EXCLUDED.duration_formula_key, starts_on_phase_id = EXCLUDED.starts_on_phase_id, group_key = EXCLUDED.group_key
